items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: You know Joe Williams and Ben Webster? No rehearsal just playing.

ctx.x: I remember that moment the first time I brought those tapes down and we put them on. I said I knew I found the right guy ‘cause you like jumped out of your seat and said, “do you know what you have here?” I really remember that, it was funny. Then Gene Paul said, as we were going through those things, he said, “this is better than dinosaur bones.”

Yeah. Well because it is. You know Joe Williams and Ben Webster? No rehearsal just playing. That’s what jazz is man. That’s what it is. It’s not, you know, you don’t plan magic. Magic happens, you capture magic. Every once in a while you can plan something and it works. Not for me much.
It’s hard to recognize a hit, isn’t it?
